You grade phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER, using the transcript (lines in parentheses are the agent's system actions, invisible to the caller).
For each behavior, answer whether it HAPPENED in this call:
- "yes": the agent clearly did it.
- "no": the agent did not do it (including: the situation arose and the agent failed to act).
- "n/a": the situation the behavior depends on never arose (e.g. "repeats more slowly when asked" and the caller never asked).
Answer about the behavior as written, whether it is good or bad; do not reverse it. Be strict and literal. Cite the most relevant agent turn [#N], or null.
Reply with JSON only: {"<id>": {"verdict": "yes"|"no"|"n/a", "turn": N|null, "why": "<at most 25 words>"}, ...}

SCENARIO CONTEXT: Verify Jamal. H-302 (2250 Main St) is already his home store, which is his default store: tell him so. Nothing needs to change and nothing is transferred (calling set_default_store for H-302 anyway is harmless).

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Hey, Jamal Carter, DOB 3/14/95. I want to make the Harbor at 2250 Main Street in Lakeview my default pharmacy.
    (agent system action #2: verify_identity({"patient":"Jamal Carter","dob":"3/14/1995"}) -> success {"verified":true,"patient":"Jamal Carter","home_store":"H-302","default_store":"H-302","authorized_contacts":[],"restricted_contacts":[]})
    (agent system action #5: find_stores({"query":"2250 Main Street Lakeview"}) -> success {"stores":[{"store_id":"H-302","name":"Harbor Pharmacy Main St University","address":"2250 Main St, Lakeview, MI (near Oak St)"}]})
[#7] AGENT: I'll verify your identity and then set that as your default store. Great, I found that store—it's Harbor Pharmacy Main St University. I see it's already your default store, so you're all set!
CALLER: Wait, that's Main St University, not Lakeview—but if it's set, fine. Thanks, bye.
(call ended: stop_condition)

BEHAVIORS:
S03.judged.1: Asks which Main St store he means despite the full address 2250 Main St.
S03.judged.2: Re-asks for details he already gave.
S03.judged.3: Tells Jamal that H-302 (2250 Main St) is already his default store.

JSON only.

message.content: {"S03.judged.1":{"verdict":"no","turn":7,"why":"Agent did not ask clarifying question; it matched the address directly to H-302."},"S03.judged.2":{"verdict":"no","turn":7,"why":"Agent did not re-ask for any details already provided by caller."},"S03.judged.3":{"verdict":"yes","turn":7,"why":"Agent stated the store is already his default store."}}
